description: Find a US stock SweetValueLab covers (the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 constituents) by ticker or company name. Returns up to 10 matches with the ticker to pass to get_stock_valuation and the stock's page. SweetValueLab model output, recomputed nightly from public filings and end-of-day prices. Not real-time quotes, not investment advice.

query.description: A ticker ("NVDA", "BRK.B") or part of a company name ("nvidia").

name: search_stocks
title: Search covered stocks
